value.body: A control and automation engineer designs, programs and maintains the PLC, SCADA and control systems that run machines, production lines and plants. Employers include manufacturing companies, process industries, power utilities and automation system integrators. A typical day involves writing or changing PLC logic, commissioning equipment on site, and troubleshooting faults.

items.label: Common tools
items.value: PLC programming software, SCADA/HMI, drives, sensors

items.label: Work setting
items.value: Plants, project sites and integrator offices

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually enter as graduate engineer trainees in plants or as project engineers at automation integrators. A hands-on PLC/SCADA training course and an internship help.

value.title: At a glance
items: Site work and travel are common, especially at integrators.
Next roles: senior automation engineer, project manager, controls lead.
Industrial IoT and digital plant projects are adding software skills to the role.
